what_to_detect: An attackers legality record where a creature has must_attack true (an attacks-if-able requirement), together with whether the creature then appears among the declared attackers of the real declaration.
near_miss: A creature with must_attack true that is not required in the declaration because it is tapped or restricted.

what_to_detect: An attackers legality record where a creature has must_attack true (an attacks-if-able requirement), together with whether the creature then appears among the declared attackers of the real declaration.
near_miss: A creature with must_attack true that is not required in the declaration because it is tapped or restricted.

what_to_detect: A combat record in which a creature declared as an attacker without vigilance is tapped in the snapshot (tapped by the attack, not as a cost).
near_miss: A declared attacker with vigilance is untapped in the same snapshot.

what_to_detect: A combat record whose attackers list holds a creature declared as an attacker, still an attacking creature at the damage step.
near_miss: A creature the attacking player controls that was not declared and is absent from the combat record's attackers.

what_to_detect: A creature enters the battlefield by an effect that would put it onto the battlefield attacking, yet is absent from every later combat record's attackers because the planeswalker or player it would attack is gone.
near_miss: The same effect with the attacked permanent or player still present: the entering creature is listed among the attackers.
record_fields: zone_change event to the battlefield on the resolution of an effect putting a creature onto the battlefield attacking (Attacking$)

what_to_detect: A creature or token put onto the battlefield attacking appears in a combat record's attackers although an attack restriction (such as a cap on the number of attackers) would have forbidden declaring it.
near_miss: A creature declared as an attacker, which the restriction applies to.

what_to_detect: A creature put onto the battlefield attacking after blockers are declared appears in a combat record's attackers with no entry in blocks.
near_miss: A creature put onto the battlefield attacking before blockers are declared, which can be blocked.

what_to_detect: A creature put onto the battlefield attacking before blockers are declared appears in combat.blocks as blocked or is available to block.
near_miss: A creature put onto the battlefield attacking after blockers are declared, which is unblocked.

what_to_detect: A resolution of an attacker's ability whose effect lands on the defending player or the controller of the attacked planeswalker (a counter_change or damage on that player), resolved from the attacker's attack target.
near_miss: The same ability whose effect lands on a player other than the attacked player's controller.

what_to_detect: An attacker whose defender was reselected (a removed_from_combat event on a ChangeCombatants resolution names it) is still listed among a later combat record's attackers, and no second attack trigger is evaluated for it.
near_miss: A creature removed from combat by a RemoveFromCombat resolution, absent from the later combat record's attackers.
record_fields: removed_from_combat event on ChangeCombatants / RemoveFromCombat resolutions

what_to_detect: An attacker whose defender was reselected (removed_from_combat on a ChangeCombatants resolution) now attacks a defender for which the declaration's attackers legality record listed it forbidden by a static, and it stays in a later combat record's attackers.
near_miss: The same creature at the declaration: the attackers legality record for that defender lists it forbidden and it is not declared against that defender.
